scientific_question: Which signed role-local descriptor mismatches remain after replacing the occurrence-weighted measured-Ugi count-program law with the group-balanced identity-free law, and which mismatches did that intervention actually reduce?
nonclaims: This is a seed-0 train-fold-only diagnostic and is not an across-training-seed or held-out model claim.
